plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-15 from the official University of Washington Bothell degree-map PDF 'B-Math-Degree-Map-2022.pdf' (printed footer 'Last updated: 09/22/2022'), hosted on uwb.edu. The map's title block prints only 'Math'; the degree is confirmed by the source document's own title ('Bachelor of Science with a major in Mathematics'). Filed under catalog_year 2022-2023: this is an ARCHIVED map, not the current catalog. The current UW Bothell catalog is 2026-2027, and the degree maps the site currently links to are UW NetID SharePoint Word documents and MyPlan, both login-walled; no login was attempted, so the public 2022 PDF is the newest publicly verifiable official term-by-term map for this program. The map calls itself 'a suggested schedule of courses based on degree requirements' and 'not a substitute for academic advising' (printed on the map). UW Bothell is a quarter-system school; the 12 blocks below are the map's 12 quarters (Autumn/Winter/Spring, Years 1-4) in printed order. The map prints no per-term totals and no degree total. No parenthetical credit number is printed anywhere on this map, so under the printed rule every slot is 5 credits, each quarter sums to 15 and the plan to 180, the standard UW Bothell bachelor's total. Non-credit parentheticals transcribed on the titles/notes, never read as credits: B MATH 123 (the code's spacing as printed) carries '(depending on math placement)'; B WRIT 135 carries '(or other 5 credit W course)'; CSS 142 carries '(with 1 credit CSSSKL 142 Skills Lab)' — the combined programming lecture+lab cell is folded into the CSS 142 entry and recorded at 5 credits under the printed rule (the parenthetical states the lab's credit, not a replacement credit for the cell), the same folding used for the companion maps. Markers are disclosed, not recorded as prerequisites (the map prints no course-to-course prerequisite chain, so no prereqs are recorded): the diamond means 'Prerequisite: Must be completed prior to applying for a major'; the checkmark means 'Milestones: Courses and special requirements necessary to timely progress through and complete a major'; the four-point marker means 'May be fulfilled with Discovery Core'; this map prints no star legend. Competitive-applicant guidance printed on the map (all prerequisites completed, 3.0 grade in each prerequisite, cumulative GPA 3.0) is disclosed here and not encoded. Per-year printed notes: Year 2 — most 300/400-level math courses require one or more of STMATH 126, 207, 208, 224, 300 and/or CSS 142 + CSSSKL 142 lab, to be taken by the end of Year 3 at the latest for a four-year completion. Year 3 — 'Students may choose between STMATH 405 in the autumn or STMATH 381 in the spring' (the two 'or Upper Division Math Elective' slots are recorded as choice slots carrying that printed wording). Year 4 — 'The math major requires 25 credits of Upper Division Math Elective coursework.' The eleven generic 'Upper Division Math, Minor or General Elective' slots are recorded as choice slots with unique synthetic codes.
